formats.name: jtorch-checkpoint
formats.notes: Versioned JSON manifest, little-endian payload, SHA-256 digest; corruption, truncation and bad magic are rejected. Supported dtypes: float32/float64/int32/int64/bool.

formats.name: safetensors
formats.notes: Reader and writer; reference file produced by safetensors 0.7.0 is read, and length/offset tampering is rejected.

unsupported: safetensors metadata blocks (ignored on read, not written)
